issues.where: cv_coordinator.md, 'Methodological experience': 'I have not led a language-model benchmarking programme, trained an acoustic foundation model or managed a multilingual model leaderboard.'; prior_project.md, 'Interviews and interpretation': 'No language-model training or leaderboard evaluation formed part of the study.'; dossier.yaml F24
issues.problem: A music-pedagogy CV and an internal teaching-project report would never disclaim language-model leaderboards or acoustic foundation models. These sentences exist only to answer the premise of the T11 trap in pub2-ka220-multilingual-stretch. Any system reading the dossier is told what the brief's suggestion will be and that it is off-limits.
issues.fix: Delete both sentences and F24. The trap is decided by the call's scope and by the positive record already in the dossier: audio annotation of pauses and overlap for teacher discussion, rubric and qualitative methods, and only studio technicians as technical staff. If a capacity limit should be recorded, state the existing technical staffing positively in consortium_and_resources.md, for example 'technical support covers studio recording and caption correction', and register that as a fact.

issues.where: All four files. consortium_and_resources.md: 'Their music and language units are internal departments, not additional partners.'; 'The signed institutional teaching collaboration does not change this status.'; 'their existence does not establish that every teaching activity or external venue is accessible'; 'The software is a teaching resource, not a validated translation system.'; 'No translation curriculum has been validated ... translator-training qualification.' cv_coordinator.md: 'I do not treat concert attendance, public performance or student satisfaction as substitutes for assessed learning.'; 'My coordination role does not give me authority to approve another institution's modules or to sign agreements on its behalf.' prior_project.md: 'not approval of a new qualification or institution-wide validation'; 'Public performances ... were not analysed as evidence of improved learning.' publications.md: 'None is under review or awaiting acceptance.'; a 'does not ...' sentence closing every annotation; 'It is the same study and sample, not an independent replication.'; 'repository availability alone has not been counted as evidence of external curriculum adoption.'
issues.problem: The dossier reads like a specification of what a proposal must not claim, not like a CV, final report or team description. Pre-emptive negations about translation qualifications, performance-as-evidence, authority limits, replication status and repository use would not appear in real documents. They point at likely brief suggestions and call exclusions. The style 'The 4 publications below' also mirrors the fact value rather than normal prose.
issues.fix: Keep the limitations a real final report states in its limitations section: no control group, assessors not blind to timing, 12 missing follow-ups, interval ignoring clustering, uptake limited to named modules, external reuse not measured. Delete the other negations. Reduce publication annotations to one or two neutral descriptive sentences, or drop them. Write 'four publications', 'Selected publications'. Rewrite F17 as a positive statement of what the language materials are (terminology sheets, seminar pack), and update F22's value to match the new wording.

issues.where: consortium_and_resources.md, legal membership table: 'Kaarensalmi University of Applied Arts; Kaarensalmen taidekorkeakoulu Oy, a Finnish limited liability company'; 'awards accredited higher education qualifications'; cv_coordinator.md header; dossier.yaml F02
issues.problem: Finnish law does not allow this combination. 'Taidekorkeakoulu' denotes an arts university, and universities are public corporations or foundations under the Universities Act 558/2009, never an Oy. Only universities of applied sciences (ammattikorkeakoulu) are run by limited companies, under Act 932/2014. The roles in the dossier are UAS roles: principal lecturer (yliopettaja), a 60 ECTS teacher-pedagogy requirement and a director of teaching development. 'University of Applied Arts' is not Finnish English usage. Finnish degrees rest on an operating licence and FINEEC audit, not 'accreditation'. Partner legal status is a quoted fact in any KA220 partner description.
issues.fix: Rename the institution to 'Kaarensalmi University of Applied Sciences; Kaarensalmen ammattikorkeakoulu Oy', with an operating licence from the Ministry of Education and Culture and music and music-pedagogy degree programmes. Replace 'accredited' with 'awards higher education degrees under its operating licence'. Update the CV header and F02 to match.

issues.where: consortium_and_resources.md, legal membership table: 'Velinac College of Music Pedagogy; Veleučilište za glazbenu pedagogiju Velinac'
issues.problem: In Croatian higher-education terminology a veleučilište is a polytechnic or university of applied sciences, while 'college' corresponds to visoka škola. The English and Croatian names describe different institution types.
issues.fix: Use either 'Velinac University of Applied Sciences (Veleučilište ...)' or 'Velinac College of Music Pedagogy (Visoka škola za glazbenu pedagogiju Velinac)'. Update F03 to match.
